mission_understanding: The mission is to harden the 4 backends (gnomledger, cappo-backend, veklom-byos-backend-2, lockerphycer) by purging references to ports 3000 and 8000, ensuring they map to their canonical ports, embedding cAPI, committing changes to a new branch named 'ops-backend-hardening', and simulating a PR push.
risks: Incorrect port mappings could lead to service unavailability or misconfiguration.
Purging references might inadvertently remove necessary configurations, causing services to fail.
Simulating a PR push without proper testing may introduce bugs into production.
forbidden_actions: Bypassing Release Control and Production Truth
definition_of_done: Purging references to ports 3000 and 8000 in all relevant files.
Ensuring the backends map to their canonical ports (Gnomledger: 8001, CAPPO: 8002, BYOS: 8088, Lockerphycer: 8092).
Embedding cAPI and ensuring it is connected.
Committing changes to the 'ops-backend-hardening' branch using git.
Simulating a PR push without pushing actual code.
